# Agent K C++ project tools

Pass a unique CMake workspace folder name, not a path. Use agent_k_cpp_language_server for semantic symbols, definitions, references, diagnostics, hover, call/type hierarchy, and explicit language-service lifecycle. Call status first and treat indexing results as partial.

Use agent_k_native_debugger instead of invoking GDB, LLDB, WinDbg, or a DAP adapter from the shell. Call status first, then configurations for launch targets or processes for an explicit attach. Preserve the returned sessionId. Set breakpoints, start, inspect stack/locals/registers/expressions/memory/disassembly, and control execution through the tool. Stop terminates the target and removes the session; detach keeps the target running and removes the session. Prefer detach for attached processes unless termination was explicitly requested. Dump sessions are read-only. Only write memory or variables in a stopped live session after an explicit user request. Addresses and instruction breakpoints are session-local because ASLR can invalidate them.
